svg.title: magnifier
svg.desc: ClimbUK hand drawn line illustration: Insight, research, looking closer. Line and fills use rgb(232, 113, 42) (default Climb Orange through --doodle-ink); cut lines use --doodle-ground (default Dark Brown).

tspan.tspan: Look through the companies attending by stage, sector and region, and
pick the ones worth a conversation.

svg.title: chat-dots
svg.desc: ClimbUK hand drawn line illustration: Chat, messages, start a conversation. Line and fills use rgb(232, 113, 42) (default Climb Orange through --doodle-ink); cut lines use --doodle-ground (default Dark Brown).

tspan.tspan: Founders request meetings. You accept the ones you want and decline the

svg.title: stopwatch
svg.desc: ClimbUK hand drawn line illustration: Countdown, quick fire sessions, time running out. Line and fills use rgb(232, 113, 42) (default Climb Orange through --doodle-ink); cut lines use --doodle-ground (default Dark Brown).

tspan.tspan: Opt in for a round of short conversations with founders from your sectors.

svg.title: people
svg.desc: ClimbUK hand drawn line illustration: Find your people. Line and fills use rgb(232, 113, 42) (default Climb Orange through --doodle-ink); cut lines use --doodle-ground (default Dark Brown).

tspan.tspan: Angels, funds and lenders in one place to compare notes and share deals.

svg.title: tickets
svg.desc: ClimbUK hand drawn line illustration: Admission tickets: get your ticket. Line and fills use rgb(232, 113, 42) (default Climb Orange through --doodle-ink); cut lines use --doodle-ground (default Dark Brown).

tspan.tspan: Apply on the investor page. Once we have verified you, your ticket is issued.
